**Reporting To:**
=================

Senior Human Resources Business Partner

**Shift:**
==========

India Standard (India)

**About Russell Investments, Mumbai:**
======================================

Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 90-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. The firm is “Top 12 Ranked Consultant (2009-2024)” in P&I survey 2024 with $1,013 billion in assets under advisement (as of June 30, 2026) and $417.5 billion in assets under management (as of June 30, 2026) for clients in 30 countries. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington in the United States, Russell Investments has offices around the world, including London, New York, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Mumbai.

Joining our Mumbai office means becoming part of a globally connected team where associates collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones to support the work of a globally recognized asset management firm. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.

For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.

**Job Description:**
====================

Russell Investments is looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition leader to manage recruitment delivery across our India business.

Our Mumbai office is Russell Investments' largest global location, supporting a diverse range of functions including Investment Division, Global Technology, Global Operations, GTM, Marketing and corporate services.

This role will lead a team of recruiters responsible for hiring across both technology and non-technology functions, with particular emphasis on specialist and technically complex roles.

We are looking for someone who combines hands-on recruitment expertise with strong business acumen, market intelligence and a data-driven approach. The successful candidate will independently manage TA operations, build a high-performing recruitment team and partner with business leaders to deliver effective hiring solutions.

The role will also work closely with the Global Talent Acquisition team to support the implementation of our evolving global TA strategy and operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition Delivery & Operations**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment delivery across technology and non-technology functions in India, ensuring hiring priorities are met while maintaining high standards of candidate quality.
* Independently manage recruitment operations, including recruiter allocation, hiring priorities, workload management and escalations.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR Business Partners on workforce requirements, hiring strategies, role expectations and recruitment challenges.
* Drive recruitment efficiency through effective intake discussions, proactive pipeline management, timely stakeholder communication and adherence to agreed service standards.
* Work closely with the Global Talent Acquisition team to implement the global TA strategy, strengthen regional collaboration and drive consistency in recruitment practices.
* Manage recruitment agencies and external partners, ensuring quality, cost effectiveness and appropriate utilisation.

**2. Specialist & Technical Recruitment**

* Personally lead recruitment for selected critical, senior and technically complex roles, particularly across Technology and Investment-related functions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical talent markets, including software engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity, AI and automation.
* Develop expertise in specialist investment talent segments such as quantitative analytics, investment risk, portfolio analytics and research.
* Build sourcing strategies for niche and hard-to-fill positions through direct sourcing, talent mapping and alternative talent pools.
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, competitor activity and emerging skill requirements to support informed hiring decisions.

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of recruiters, building accountability, independence and consistency in recruitment delivery.
* Set clear expectations around recruiter productivity, hiring quality, stakeholder management and service standards.
* Conduct regular recruitment reviews, provide feedback and address performance or capability gaps within the team.
* Build functional expertise across the team and encourage knowledge-sharing between technology and non-technology recruitment verticals.
* Foster a culture of ownership, where recruiters proactively resolve challenges, manage stakeholders and make informed recommendations.

**4. Recruitment Analytics & Reporting**

* Own recruitment reporting and dashboards, providing visibility into hiring progress, pipeline health, time-to-fill, source effectiveness and recruiter productivity.
* Analyse recruitment data to identify trends, anticipate hiring challenges and recommend improvements to recruitment strategies.
* Present meaningful hiring insights and recommendations to HR and business leaders.
* Ensure data accuracy and reporting discipline across Workday and other recruitment systems.

**5. Process Improvement & Candidate Experience**

* Drive consistent adoption of recruitment processes, interview frameworks, assessment standards and hiring governance.
* Partner with hiring managers and HRBPs to improve interview effectiveness, candidate evaluation and hiring decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify recruitment workflows, improve turnaround times and reduce unnecessary administrative activities.
* Support the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled recruitment tools, automation and sourcing technologies.
* Ensure a positive, transparent and professional experience for candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Promote fair, inclusive and evidence-based hiring practices in line with company policies and applicable regulations.

**What You'll Bring**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 3 years of direct people management experience.
* Proven experience managing recruitment delivery across both technology and non-technology functions.
* Strong hands-on technical recruitment experience, with the ability to independently manage complex and niche hiring requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop recruiters while managing multiple hiring priorities.
* Strong understanding of the Indian talent market, sourcing channels, compensation trends and specialist talent pools.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using recruitment data to influence decisions and improve hiring outcomes.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders, influencing hiring decisions and managing challenging recruitment situations.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment reporting tools.
* Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of recruitment delivery.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience recruiting within BFSI, investment management, asset management, fintech or global capability centres.
* Exposure to quantitative, investment analytics, risk or other specialist financial-services hiring.
* Experience working in a global or matrixed organisation, supporting stakeholders across multiple regions.
* Experience with Workday Recruiting, talent intelligence platforms, recruitment automation or AI-enabled sourcing solutions.
* Experience implementing recruitment process improvements or TA transformation initiatives.
* Advanced Excel, Power BI or similar data-visualisation capabilities.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 3-6 months, we would expect you to:

* Establish strong ownership of day-to-day recruitment delivery, with minimal escalation required for routine hiring matters.
* Build a recruitment team that operates with greater independence, accountability and functional expertise.
* Develop credible relationships with hiring managers and HRBPs, providing proactive recruitment advice and market intelligence.
* Improve recruitment reporting, pipeline visibility and consistency in stakeholder communication.
* Demonstrate successful delivery of specialist and technically complex hiring requirements.
* Contribute to the implementation of global TA initiatives and identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency and candidate experience.

**Why Join Russell Investments?**

At Russell Investments, you will have the opportunity to work across a diverse range of business functions within a global investment solutions organisation.

This role offers exposure to specialist talent markets, global stakeholders and ongoing TA transformation initiatives, while providing the opportunity to shape recruitment delivery and develop a high-performing team.

You will play an important role in building the talent and capabilities that support our business in India and globally.

The ideal candidate should have proven experience working in the US IT staffing industry, handling W2, C2C, 1099, C2H, and permanent hiring requirements, successfully placing candidates, and coordinating directly with client-side recruiters, account managers, and hiring managers.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have established relationships within the US IT staffing industry and can contribute to expanding FyerX's client and recruitment partner network through genuine business introductions and relationship development.

* Maintain accurate candidate records, client requirements, recruitment activities, and submission trackers using Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, VMS, or Excel.
* Build and maintain an active network of qualified IT professionals for immediate and upcoming staffing requirements.
* Monitor US recruitment market trends, technology hiring demands, contract rates, and candidate availability.
* Meet assigned recruitment delivery, candidate submission, interview, closure, and client partnership targets.
* Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, compliance, and ethical standards when handling candidate information and client relationships.

If you have strong experience in US IT recruitment, a proven record of successful placements, and established professional relationships within the US IT staffing industry, we encourage you to apply for the **US IT Recruiter** role at **FyerX**.

**Your Role at Baxter**

  
  

Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit develops innovative solutions that help clinicians monitor and manage chronic and acute respiratory and cardiac conditions, improving patient outcomes and quality of life. The Principal Engineer, Toxicology & Biocompatibility serves as the subject matter expert for biocompatibility and toxicological safety across the Front-Line Care portfolio, including patient monitors, cardiology devices, vision care products, respiratory systems, non-invasive ventilation (NIV) devices, masks, breathing circuits, tubing, humidification systems, and accessories.

This role is responsible for developing toxicology strategies, conducting risk assessments, supporting regulatory submissions, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. The position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Manager, Systems Front-Line Care.

  
  
  

**What you'll be doing**

  
  

* Lead biocompatibility and toxicology activities across Front Line Care products in accordance with global regulatory and quality requirements.
* Independently develop and execute Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) in compliance with ISO 10993-1.
* Author, review, and approve Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) in accordance with ISO 10993-17.
* Evaluate chemical safety risks associated with device materials, manufacturing processes, and intended use conditions.
* Collaborate with laboratory partners and cross-functional stakeholders on material characterization programs per ISO 10993-18.
* Serve as the toxicology lead for respiratory and non-invasive ventilation products, including masks, breathing circuits, tubing, connectors, and humidification systems.
* Assess inhalation exposure risks and evaluate the impact of heat, moisture, airflow, volatile compounds, and long-term off-gassing in respiratory devices in accordance with ISO 18562.
* Assess risks associated with cleaning, disinfection, and reprocessing residues on medical devices.
* Support material selection decisions and supplier qualification activities from a toxicological and biocompatibility perspective.
* Provide toxicology expertise for FDA submissions, EU MDR Technical Documentation, and global regulatory filings.
* Act as the primary toxicology representative during regulatory interactions and audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards including ISO 10993, ISO 14971, and relevant global regulatory requirements.
* Partner with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Materials Engineering teams to guide product development decisions.
* Evaluate the toxicological impact of design, process, material, and supplier changes throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive risk-based decision making and provide scientifically sound recommendations to support product safety and regulatory compliance.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in toxicology, biocompatibility, or biological safety assessments within the medical device industry.
* Strong hands-on experience performing biocompatibility evaluations in accordance with ISO 10993 standards.
* Direct experience with respiratory device evaluations and requirements outlined in ISO 18562.
* Demonstrated expertise in assessing inhalation and respiratory exposure risks.
* Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and global regulatory submissions.
* Proven ability to independently develop biological safety strategies and execute complex toxicological assessments.
* Strong understanding of risk management principles and application of ISO 14971.
* Experience identifying toxicological risks early in product development and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Ability to develop efficient, scientifically justified, and regulatory-defensible testing strategies.
* Demonstrated success in supporting regulatory approvals without biocompatibility-related delays.
* Strong technical influence and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with suppliers, external laboratories, and third-party partners.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, international medical device standards, and product development processes.
* Understanding of the design, development, and manufacturing of electromechanical medical devices and systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results within project timelines.
* Self-motivated professional with excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced, quality-focused medical device environment.

**Job Overview**  
  
  

The Payroll & Benefits Specialist will help us manage and execute our payroll and benefits programs. Reporting to the Director, Talent in India, this role will focus on administering and executing payroll and benefits processes. We are looking for a stellar candidate with strong execution skills, who is well-versed with industry insights and practical knowledge on all payroll and benefits matters.

  
  
**About Us**  
  
  

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end-to-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise-grade hiring technology, AI-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
  

* Responsible for delivering agreed payroll and benefits programs for India, ensuring our programs conform with local market practices and follow legal requirements.
* Manage relationships with relevant vendors and client groups aligned to payroll and benefits.
* Maintain detailed project management plans for the implementation of identified payroll and benefits programs in India, including the implementation and maintenance of these processes and programs, and support the review of new proposals.
* Effectively manage payroll operations for India – payroll inputs, adjustments, off-cycle payments reconciliation, and advising and monitoring effective and timely operations working with the payroll vendor.
* Manage and advise on payroll-related compliances working with vendors and internal teams.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records, collaborate with the internal team in periodic audits, and ensure proper statutory deductions including income tax, provident fund, employee state insurance, professional tax, and other applicable contributions in compliance with Indian labor laws.
* Manage the day-to-day administration of our wellness and benefits offerings. Conduct benefits benchmarking and share findings to support reviews of our benefits offerings against our employer value proposition.
* Present the payroll and benefits overview in relevant forums (new hire orientation, employee sessions, etc.) and address all employee queries as a point person.
* Work closely with all vendors (medical, payroll, benefits) in addressing issues in the moment and helping us create an optimal employee experience.
* Recommend and implement improvements to payroll and benefits processes and systems, document the processes for internal and external stakeholders. Provide guidance/training to the Tier I team on various payroll/benefits-related inquiries.
* Participate in system upgrades, testing, and configuration of HRIS/payroll modules.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and enhance payroll and benefits processes, including HRIS/payroll system integrations, upgrades, testing and implementations.

  
**Qualifications**  
  
  

* Graduation from any business school with a human resource or business-related degree.
* 4-6 years of experience working in the HR domain with at least 3 years' experience focused on managing payroll and benefits programs for India.
* Strong hands-on experience in end-to end India payroll processing, payroll compliance, taxation and statutory requirements.
* Experience working for international companies with payroll and benefits experience; a consulting background is preferable.
* Strong communication skills, able to influence stakeholders with compelling data analysis and storytelling.
* Expertise in budgeting, vendor assessment, data requirement gathering, project management, and process documentation & governance.
* Strong networks and connections within peer companies.
* Thorough understanding of the market landscape and practices in the payroll and benefits space.
* Experience solving complex payroll and benefits problems, implementing practical process improvements, and delivering results with specialist domain knowledge and technical expertise in payroll and benefits.
* Experience managing vendor-related implementations, change management, and implementation.
* Working knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, payroll systems, and HRIS platforms, with strong excel and analytical skills
* Analytical bias, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to analyze data trends and themes.
* Comfortable with complex data, with a strength in using Excel and strong data analytical skills.
* Able to demonstrate confidence, influence, and credibility.
* Able to work under pressure and maintain attention to detail.
* Strong focus on optimizing for technology and efficiency.

  
**EEO Statement**  
  
  

ICIMS is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at ICIMS. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you’d like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at careers@icims.com.

  
  
**Compensation and Benefits**  
  
  

Competitive health and wellness benefits include medical insurance (employee and dependent family members), personal accident and group term life insurance, bonding and parental leave, lifestyle spending account reimbursements, wellness services offerings, sick and casual/emergency days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, retirals (PF - employer contribution) and gratuity. description:
Req ID: 64946

Job Function: Product & Propositions

Posting Start Date: 24/11/2026

Posting End Date: 26/11/2026

Division: Digital

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld, IND-Gurugram-IQ

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**

**Hiring Manager: Franzi Brandenburger**

**Career Grade: D**

**About the role**
------------------

At the heart of our digital transformation there is measurable shift in focus from projects and activities to products and outcomes. The Data Product Owner is key for this shift to happen. A set of empowered individuals living and breathing the ideation, definition and delivery of data products, services and solutions for our customers and wider business.

Working to support the Solution Delivery Lead for Service, you will partner with the CFU’s (Business & International) to capture and manage demand. Prioritise demands in the units based on speed and value. You will also define the execution model required to deliver best in class solutions for the business.
  

* Embed -> Resource provisioning
* Partner -> Squad provisioning
* Enable -> Direct outcome delivery

  

Key Responsibilities:
  

* Manages and qualifies the demand with the other functions in Data / Digital
* Manages the delivered products in their entire lifecycle (working with the other functions)
* Works with the rest of the units, CFUs and Business Operations to properly interlock cost and value
* Agree / interlock an adoption strategy
* Manges the delivery of use cases and the necessary data/telemetry for the Domain across the units.

You will leverage your deep understanding of data, industry best practices, your business values coupled with strong agile and technical delivery practices to deliver best in class solutions for our customers that drive value to BT’s bottom line.

  

Key responsibilities of the role
  

* Product delivery and iteration planning
* Create, maintain and regularly iterate a roadmap and backlog for your squad.
* Definition and monitoring of product performance indicators
* Leading the squad responsible for product delivery of the owned products
* Input in the demand management process in terms of classification/qualification/resourcing of the demand, working with the Solution Leads.
* A customer-centric Approach: Focus on user needs and preferences. By understanding and prioritizing customer requirements, the Data Product Owner will ensure that data products meet user expectations and deliver value. This customer-centric approach is essential for creating products that resonate with users and drive user satisfaction.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* **Understanding business needs:** deeply understand the organization's goals, challenges, and opportunities, aligning data strategies with overarching business objectives to positively drive growth transformation across the business.
* **Translation and Communication:** translate complex technical concepts into understandable language for non-technical stakeholders. Effective communication ensures that business leaders and decision-makers comprehend the value and implications of data solutions.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Building strong relationships with business CFU’s, Digital departments, and teams is a key aspect of this role. True partnering and collaboration with stakeholders to identify their specific needs and requirements, but also to trigger and generate new ideas/opportunities, supported by the other capability teams and the area Solutions Leads.
* **ROI Assessment and tracking coordination:** Assess the return on investment (ROI) for data initiatives, helping organizations make informed decisions about resource allocation and project prioritization.
* **Change Management:** Implementing data solutions often involves organizational changes. This role helps manage these changes, working with the change teams and Product Owners and Solutions Leads, including training and support for employees adapting to new technologies and workflows.
* **Strategic Planning:** Contributing to the development of data strategies, ensuring they align with the broader business strategy and long-term vision.
* **Continuous Improvement:** The role involves monitoring the performance of data solutions, identifying areas for improvement, and adjusting to maximize their impact on the business.
* **Collaborate** closely with engineering, design, data science, and other cross-functional teams to define data product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure timely and successful product delivery.
* **Serve as a subject matter expert** across a range data-led solution management activities providing guidance and support to internal stakeholders, customers, and partners.
* Define and track key solutions metrics to measure product performance and success, using data insights to drive decision-making and optimize product features.
* Works closely with and manages stakeholder priorities, aligning needs with resources ensuring cadence with customer value, business value, and strategic fit.
* Articulates formal and detailed business case projections ahead of new functionality releases and continued monitoring after release.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Leadership:** Leadership skills help in influencing and guiding teams and stakeholders toward common goals and objectives.
* **Business Acumen:** A deep understanding of the organization's industry, business model and goals is a must for this role. Strong commercial acumen is also required to assess business benefits/realisation mapping Data initiatives to the company's strategic objectives.
* **Data Literacy:** Proficiency in understanding and interpreting data. This includes the ability to grasp data concepts, recognize patterns, and understand the implications of data analysis on business decisions.
* **Technical Knowledge:** A foundational understanding of data technologies, tools, and methodologies is important. While not necessarily hands-on, this knowledge helps in effective communication and decision-making.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Building and maintaining relationships with various stakeholders, including business leaders, data scientists, and IT professionals. This involves active listening and understanding diverse perspectives.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills are vital for translating complex technical information into business terms. This role must convey the value and impact of data initiatives to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Project Management:** Strong project management skills enable the Lead to oversee and coordinate data projects, ensuring they stay on track, meet deadlines, and align with business objectives.
* **ROI Assessment:** The ability to evaluate the return on investment for data projects is crucial for prioritizing initiatives that provide the most significant business value.
* **Strategic Thinking:** The ability to think strategically and align data initiatives with long-term business goals is a critical skill for driving sustainable impact.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Analytical skills help in evaluating the potential impact of data projects on business outcomes and in making data-driven decisions.
* **Conflict Resolution:** Being able to address conflicts and resolve issues that may arise between different stakeholders or within project teams.
* **Adaptability:** The ability to adapt to changing business conditions and evolving technologies is important in the rapidly evolving field of data and AI.

BT is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

  

BT ’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

  

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

  

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

**Position Title:** Services Principal Consultant, Engineering

**Location:** Hyderabad India

**Employment:** Regular, full time, hybrid work arrangements

**Job Purpose**

The AVEVA Services Principal Consultant is an integral and highly visible part of the AVEVA Unified Engineering (UE) Services delivery team that works off and on site to deliver the AVEVA Unified Engineering solutions (AVEVA E3D, Engineering, Electrical, Instrumentation, and P&ID) to our clients. The Principal Consultant is the lead consultant on implementations for their specific solution(s) under UE and is responsible for leading business design workshops, gathering requirements, analyzing, designing, and delivering the solution with configuration, testing, training, and support. This is a key role in contributing to the growth and success of our Engineering Business Area within the region.

**Specific Solution for this Job Opportunity**

AVEVA Engineering enables multi-discipline teams of engineers to work effectively together to develop and maintain the detailed definition of all the key engineering items involved in plant or marine projects.  
AVEVA Engineering is highly versatile and configurable. It is typically used as an authoring tool for the process and mechanical disciplines, but is equally well suited for pipe stress, safety or other specialist disciplines. It enables each discipline to retain full control of their own data while being able to access and reference data from other disciplines. When used as part of AVEVA Unified Engineering the complete project information model is exposed to the full range of AVEVA’s process simulation, design, engineering, collaboration and lifecycle management technologies which can be securely accessed from a single data hub on cloud via AVEVA™ Connect.

**Key Accountabilities**

The role’s key responsibilities within the AVEVA Unified Engineering Services Delivery team are:

* Lead technical discovery workshops with clients to capture functional requirements based on definition of customer business processes and workflows
* To provide an overall plan for the deployment of the AVEVA Solutions
* Author all required documentation, capturing the design decisions made throughout the discovery and design phases
* Develop Data Model for AVEVA E3D, Engineering, Electrical, Instrumentation, and/or P&ID
* Configure the relevant application(s) based on documented specifications that have been agreed upon with the Customer to support integrations between the solutions within UE
* Work directly with Customer Lead Users to optimise the configuration and use of the system
* Manage any User Acceptance Testing that is required through to completion and acceptance by the Customer
* Train customer users on effective use of the configured system
* Identify opportunities to optimize customer business process and workflows using the AVEVA Unified Engineering solution
* Develop, update, and improve Unified Engineering Services toolkits necessary for providing best practice guidelines to customers
* Work with the AVEVA Customer Support Team to resolve customer queries requiring 2nd Line Support
* Engaging with and supporting AVEVA Product Teams and clients with requirements, analysis, design and consultancy relating to product improvements and enhancement requests

**Measures of Success**

  

* Excellent understanding of one or more AVEVA Unified Engineering solutions
* Compliance with AVEVA’s software delivery and implementation methodology
* Successful implementation of one or more AVEVA Unified Engineering solutions
* Providing a clear picture on the implementation and delivery risks and progress
* Working within a dynamic team and showing flexibility in the use and development of personal and technical skills to maximize the team’s efficiency

**Essential Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

  

* Experience in a consulting role in implementing enterprise software solutions serving any of the following: - Oil and Gas, Marine, Mining, Power & Utilities, Infrastructure, Plant Owner Operators, EPC’s or other asset intensive organizations
* Previous experience using AVEVA Engineering or similar industrial engineering software solution
* Deep understanding of AVEVA Engineering, or similar, training and configuration activities
* Previous experience with more than one of the tools that make up the AVEVA Unified Engineering solution is a bonus
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic team
* Willingness to travel within the region and, if needed on occasion, abroad to perform consultancy tasks
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate the needs/problems of prospective customers with little guidance
* The ability to effectively manage and handle multiple and possibly competing commitments simultaneously
* Experience in customer-facing skills and the ability to present product and solutions and deliver training
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Project experience supporting systems integrations
* Proven experience with technical proposals and the creation of proof-of-concept demonstrations
* Extensive and proven experience and knowledge:
* o In the Oil and Gas, Marine, Mining, Power and Utilities or Infrastructure industries
* o Have either an owner-operator or EPC contractor background
* Engineering Degree or have a comparable professional qualification or equivalent experience
* PML/ C# /.Net programming skills (secondary)
* Good level IT skills (software installations/configuration, client/server, cloud, SaaS)
* Excellent problem solving and decision-making ability
* Ability to work to deadlines

**Behaviors**

  

* Collaborative and supportive approach to team working
* Approachable, personable, ethical with a sense of humour
* Demonstrate integrity at all times
* Analytical
* Independent, self-motivated
* Flexible, adaptable
* Comfortable when presenting and leading workshops to a large audience
* Persuasive to support negotiating deliverables to clients within time and budget constraints
* Professional and thorough approach to all activities
* Commercially-focused

**Key Working Relationships**

  

* Clients/Prospects: Develop good working relationships with clients and always provide the highest level of customer service and professionalism
* AVEVA Services Principal Lead Consultant
* Sales: Work with the sales team in identifying opportunities, providing support at all levels of prospect engagement and ensuring throughout that proposed solutions are workable and are in-line with AVEVA’s strategic objectives

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be brilliant.

**About the Business Unit**

Global Delivery Services Centre (GDSC) is a high-impact business unit within Mott MacDonald, dedicated to enhancing project delivery across our global operations.

As part of GDSC, you’ll join a team that champions excellence in both technical and digital disciplines, supporting projects at every stage of the lifecycle—from concept to completion. We work to international design standards and regulations, ensuring our contributions meet the highest benchmarks of quality and innovation.

At GDSC, you’ll be empowered to collaborate across borders, grow your expertise, and make a meaningful impact on Buildings projects that shape communities worldwide.

As part of GDSC in India, you will be working alongside Mott MacDonald international colleagues delivering ambitious projects across a broad range of building types including commercial, residential, retail and offices, education, healthcare, airports, data center, hotels, sports and events venues, Theme parks, Airport and Metro stations. Under this sector, our services span the whole asset cycle from advisory to consulting, through design and delivery, to asset management. With deep understanding of all phases of the building lifecycle, it enables us to give our clients the best-informed engineering and innovative solutions.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Lead – Structural Engineering** to join our Global Delivery Services team in India, supporting the delivery of major **Australian building projects**.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across structural engineering projects, working closely with Australian project teams to develop safe, efficient, buildable and sustainable structural solutions. The role will combine **hands-on engineering, technical review, design leadership, multidisciplinary coordination and mentoring**.

**Key Deliverables**

* Lead structural design and analysis of **reinforced concrete, post-tensioned concrete and structural steel buildings** from concept through detailed design.
* Establish structural schemes, framing systems, load paths, stability systems and design methodologies.
* Provide technical leadership for complex structural engineering problems and critical design decisions.
* Experience on international codes is mandatory while on Australian codes is advantageous.
* Lead and independently review structural calculations, analysis models, design reports, specifications, drawings and BIM deliverables.
* Perform **technical reviews, design checks and constructability reviews** and drive engineering quality throughout project delivery.
* Coordinate closely with Australian project teams, architects, geotechnical, civil and building services disciplines.
* Support resolution of design interfaces, technical queries, RFIs and construction-stage issues.
* Lead and mentor structural engineers and BIM teams, providing technical guidance and developing engineering capability.
* Drive **value engineering, standardisation, digital delivery and design optimisation**.
* Manage technical delivery against programme, budget, quality and project requirements.

The emphasis on team leadership, multidisciplinary coordination, design reviews, BIM/ACC workflows and responding to RFIs is also consistent with recent structural-lead experience being considered internally for Australia/ANZ delivery.

**Key Capabilities**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Civil/Structural Engineering**.
* Typically **13+ years of structural engineering experience**, with substantial experience in building structures.
* Strong technical expertise in **reinforced concrete and structural steel design**.
* Experience with **post-tensioned structures, high-rise buildings and complex building structures** would be advantageous.
* Australian project experience and strong working knowledge of **Australian Standards** highly desirable.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams and independently review complex structural designs.
* Strong understanding of **structural behaviour, lateral stability, serviceability, robustness, durability and constructability**.
* Experience coordinating structural solutions with architects, MEP, geotechnical and civil disciplines.
* Excellent technical communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**Software & Digital Skills**

Strong experience with relevant structural analysis/design tools such as:

* **ETABS**
* **RAM Concept**
* **RAPT**
* **SAFE**
* **SpaceGASS**
* **Robot Structural Analysis**
* **Tekla Structural Designer**
* **Revit / Autodesk Construction Cloud**

**Professional Qualifications**

* Chartered or equivalent professional status is desirable.
* **CPEng / NER through Engineers Australia**, or demonstrated progression toward equivalent professional recognition, would be advantageous.
* Strong commitment to technical excellence, safety, quality and continuous professional development.

**What We're Looking For**

A **hands-on technical leader** who will be capable of taking ownership of challenging structural engineering problems, providing authoritative technical guidance to the delivery team, working effectively with Australian stakeholders, and developing the next generation of structural engineers.

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

description:
This is a remote position.

**Company:** Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc. (BFG Tax) | **Location:** India, remote (Kochi preferred; qualified applicants

across India welcome)

  

**Engagement**: Independent consultant, fixed-fee project | **Initial duration**: Approximately 4-6 weeks

Reports to: Founder & CEO | Collaborates with: Finance, Delivery, Marketing, Sales and U.S. Securities & Corporate

Attorney

  

**1. About BFG Tax**

BFG Tax is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, payroll and financial advisory business established in 2004. The company is

planning industry-focused expansion supported by marketing, customer acquisition, technology, strategic partnerships and

centralized service delivery.

  

**2. Position Overview**

  

We seek a hands-on fractional CFO or corporate finance specialist in India to develop investor-ready financial models,

forecasts, valuation scenarios and capital requirements for a U.S. private fundraising initiative. This is not a routine

bookkeeping, tax compliance or accounting management position.

  

**3. Fundraising Project**

  

Stage Proposed funding objective

1 - Existing client relationships $50,000-$100,000

2 - Additional private investors Balance required to reach $250,000 cumulative

3 - Potential subsequent round $750,000

Overall potential financing Up to $1,000,000

Management is considering business loans, equity and convertible notes for the initial financing. The CFO will evaluate

financial implications; U.S. legal counsel will determine legal feasibility and securities compliance. The CFO must

independently assess whether proposed funding amounts are appropriate.

  

**4. Key Responsibilities**

  

A. Historical Financial Review

* Review historical income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, liabilities and operating costs.

* Reconcile records supplied by the Finance Manager; identify gaps and material assumptions.

* Separate recurring, one-time, seasonal and project-based revenue and analyze revenue by service.

* Assess cash balances, outstanding loans, working capital and U.S.-India cost arrangements.

B. Financial Modeling and Forecasting

* Build an integrated, formula-driven and editable Microsoft Excel financial model.

  

BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 2

* Prepare monthly 2027 forecasts, detailed January-June 2027 cash flow, a rolling 13-week cash forecast, and three-year

projections.

* Produce conservative, base and growth scenarios, break-even, cash runway and sensitivity analysis.

* Document data sources, drivers, assumptions and model checks.

C. Marketing and Customer Acquisition

* Model the proposed January-June 2027 advertising budget of $155,000, subject to approval.

* Analyze lead costs, lead qualification, conversion, onboarding, acquisition costs and recurring-revenue timing.

* Test retention, service delivery costs, contribution margin and alternative marketing spend levels.

D. Capital Requirements and Use of Funds

* Determine minimum viable capital needs and recommended financing schedule.

* Produce use-of-funds and liquidity scenarios for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.

* Assess operating reserves, funding milestones, and the timing and need for a later $750,000 round.

E. Financing Alternatives

* Compare business loans, equity and convertible notes.

* Model debt service, repayment, interest, dilution, conversion and subsequent fundraising effects.

* Coordinate with securities counsel on S corporation constraints and permissible instruments; do not provide legal opinions.

F. Valuation and Investor Materials

* Prepare supportable valuation methodologies and pre-/post-money capitalization scenarios.

* Clearly distinguish total annual revenue from recurring revenue.

* Prepare financial exhibits, risks, assumptions, sensitivities and presentation-ready schedules.

  

**5. Required Deliverables**

  

* Historical financial review and findings memorandum.

* Fully editable, integrated Excel model with transparent assumptions and formulas.

* January-June 2027 cash-flow forecast and rolling 13-week cash forecast.

* Three-year financial projections and conservative/base/growth scenarios.

* Marketing and customer acquisition model.

* Use-of-funds schedules for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.

* Debt, equity and convertible-note financial comparison.

* Valuation, capitalization and dilution scenarios.

* Investor-ready financial summary and supporting exhibits.

* Written recommendations on funding amount, timing and financial risks.

* Management presentation and handover of all model files.

  

**6. Required Qualifications**

  

* CA, CPA, CFA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent professional qualification; preferably 10+ years relevant experience.

* Proven investor-ready modeling work for U.S. businesses, including financial statements and cash-flow analysis.

* Advanced Excel skills, valuation, capitalization and scenario modeling.

* Understanding of U.S. financial reporting and strong written/spoken English.

* Availability for scheduled U.S. Eastern Time meetings.

  

BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 3

  

**7. Preferred Experience**

  

* Fractional CFO or transaction advisory work for U.S. small and midsize businesses.

* Private fundraising, recurring-revenue economics and professional services businesses.

* U.S.-India outsourced operations and cross-border financial analysis.

* Investor/lender due diligence; familiarity with Xero, QuickBooks or Zoho Books.

  

**8. Timeline and Compensation**

  

The engagement is expected to last approximately 4-6 weeks. An initial financial assessment and preliminary model are

expected within 1-2 weeks, followed by iterative review and final delivery. Candidates should propose a realistic milestone

schedule and fixed-fee quote, identifying payment milestones, assumptions, exclusions, revision costs and possible ongoing

advisory support.

The consultant is not authorized to solicit investors, negotiate securities transactions or receive transaction-based fundraising

compensation under this engagement.

  

**9. Application Requirements**

  

* Resume or firm profile and summary of relevant U.S. work.

* Two or three comparable project examples; redacted model sample where permitted.

* Proposed approach, project timeline, fixed-fee quote and earliest start date.

* References from relevant U.S. or international clients where available.

  

**10. Selection Process**

  

Shortlisted applicants will complete a technical interview covering minimum funding requirements, marketing-led cash

forecasts, a $100,000 debt-versus-equity comparison, valuation and dilution, and investor due diligence. A short paid

modeling exercise may be used for finalists.

  

**11. Confidentiality and Ownership**

  

Engagement is subject to signed confidentiality and consulting agreements. All BFG-specific models and deliverables must

be handed over in editable form, with ownership and permitted reuse governed by contract. Confidential company, client,

employee and investor information must be handled under approved security procedures.

**Organisational Development Consultant**
=========================================

Req ID: 128597

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Advisor - Organisation Design & Implementationin Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

Supporting the development of high-quality insights, recommendations and deliverables that help leaders make informed decisions and enable successful implementation. This may include owning defined workstreams, coordinating project activities, conducting analysis, preparing materials, managing risks and dependencies, and partnering with stakeholders across the business and T&C.

  

The role plays an important part in helping OD&I deliver practical, evidence-based and people-centred outcomes. It requires strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and delivery skills, with the ability to work through complexity, manage competing priorities and contribute to successful transformation outcome.

  

The degree of autonomy, program size / complexity and leadership responsibility will vary depending on the level of the role.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Permanent  
**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru  
**Work Hours:**  
Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)

  

**Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position.**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Supporting the delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Owning or contributing to defined project workstreams, ensuring activities are delivered to a high standard and aligned to agreed outcomes.
* Conducting organisational and workforce analysis to support insights and recommendations, including structure, spans and layers, role design, capability, governance and implementation considerations.
* Preparing high-quality project deliverables, including analysis, options, recommendations, stakeholder packs, governance materials, implementation plans and progress updates.
* Supporting the development of evidence-based recommendations that balance business outcomes, customer impacts, workforce experience, financial objectives and enterprise design principles.
* Working with business leaders, T&C Business Partners, T&C teams and cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, test insights and support delivery.
* Supporting governance activities, including project planning, status reporting, issue and risk management, dependency tracking and action management.
* Supporting the translation of organisation design recommendations into practical implementation activities, including role mapping, consultation support, transition planning or implementation tracking.
* Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience contributing to people, workforce, organisation design, operating model, or business transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of one or more OD&I core capabilities, such as organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise workforce, organisational and business information.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality presentations, papers, updates and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity and deliver quality outcomes in a complex environment.
* Ability to think systemically, connecting organisational, operational, customer, financial and people impacts when developing analysis and recommendations
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Business Consulting QAS- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**

**Profile: Senior Consultant - Model Validator - Generative AI**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across global banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.

  

EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* MRM (SR 11-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state-of-the-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
* Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark and PyTorch. Knowledge in AutoML tools which are used for automating the machine learning pipeline and Auto Kubernetes for managing containerized applications.
* Experience with cloud-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models, such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud AI.
* Experience is writing validation reports as per MRM practices.

  

**What We Look For**

* Undergraduate (4-year degree) or master’s or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Engineering, Computational Finance, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with hands-on experience.
* Relevant certifications in AI/RAI from GARP/ Quantitative courses such as CQF.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

**Description**

**Your Role**

A s a BIM Modeller f or Data Centre projects, you will support the delivery of complex, high-performance critical facilities projects through accurate BIM development, documentation, and multidisciplinary coordination.

You will work closely with architects, engineers, BIM leaders, consultants, and other stakeholders to translate design intent and technical information into reliable, information-rich models and model-derived documentation. In doing so, you will maintain project standards, data integrity, and delivery requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, BIM leaders, consultants and project teams, you will translate d esign intent and technical information into accurate, coordinated and information-rich BIM models and documentation.

Based in our Mumbai office, you will be part of a distributed APME project delivery team. You will work with design and project teams across different offices and maintain sufficient working-hour overlap to receive instructions, resolve queries and coordinate priorities effectively. You will also work very closely with the Regional Design Technology team to bring the innovation, standards, and automation the firm is developing into your Centre of Excellence.

  

**Professional Traits**

* You take pride in getting the details right and are naturally self-critical about your own work.
* You are patient and curious with technical complexity, and you enjoy making sense of dense, multidisciplinary information.
* You are dependable, self-directed, with genuine ownership of your work and a strong sense of accountability when working with local and remote teams.
* You are collaborative and open to feedback, and you are comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.
You have a genuine appetite to learn, and you are open to new digital-delivery methods, automation and continuous improvement.  

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Develop and maintain high-quality architectural BIM models in Autodesk Revit Architecture in line with project requirements, design intent, BIM standards, and project milestones.
* Produce accurate plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, and sheets, keeping BIM content consistent with issued drawings.
* You translate drawings, sketches, specifications, consultant inputs, and mark-ups into coordinated digital models.
* You proactively identify missing information, modelling inconsistencies, and potential technical conflicts, and communicate them clearly.
* Develop assigned model content to the agreed Level of Development and information requirements, following the BIM Execution Plan, naming conventions, worksharing procedures, and information-exchange protocols.
* Maintain correct model geometry, coordinates, and data integrity throughout project development and self-check before publishing and audit .
* Manage assigned model areas with other modellers and stakeholders to avoid gaps and duplication of efforts.
* Reuse and extend standardised components across repeated zones, phases, and campuses, working at speed to meet fast-track programmes without compromising accuracy.
* Raise modelling and coordination issues with the BIM leadership team.
* Participate in BIM, design, and coordination meetings when required, follow through on assigned actions.
* Take direction from remote design leads and project teams and report on progress.
Contribute lessons learned and practical improvements to modelling workflows, Revit content, templates, and production efficiency.  

  

**Your Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technology, Civil Engineering, Construction Technology, and/or a related built-environment discipline.
* 2–5 years of professional BIM modelling experience, preferably within an architecture, engineering, construction, or multidisciplinary design environment.
* Previous exposure to data centres, critical facilities & buildings or other technically complex and services-intensive projects
* Excellent at producing accurate, coordinated BIM models and drawings in accordance with project standards and delivery requirements.

* Excellent proficiency in Autodesk Revit Architecture, including model development, worksharing , linked models, families, views, sheets, schedules, parameters, and documentation.
* Strong understanding of construction documentation, detailing, building components, and multidisciplinary project information.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, sketches, specifications, mark-ups, schedules, and consultant information.
* Working knowledge of Navisworks for model review and coordination support, and familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud/Forma for cloud collaboration, document management, and issue workflows.
* Awareness of BIM Execution Plans, LOD/LOI requirements, Common Data Environments, naming conventions, revision control, and ISO 19650 principles.
Strong, proactive communication in clear written and spoken English, within your own team and across the wider regional team, with the organisational and time-management skills to work effectively across time zones.  

  

**Additional Skills**

  

* Autodesk Certified Professional in Revit or a comparable BIM certification.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD and Rhino and their interoperability with Revit.
* Experience collaborating across geographically distributed or international project teams.
* Interest in emerging BIM technologies, automation, AI-assisted workflows, and continuous improvement of digital project delivery.
* Experience with Revizto , BIM Collaborate Pro, BIM Track, ProjectWise, Aconex, Asite , or similar platforms.

description:
**About the role**
------------------

Nexus is Corporater's new platform for managing leads, cases, partners and the sales pipeline, built in-house as a custom application on AWS.

As Tech Lead, you will lead a small team of two developers and one QA engineer. This is a hands-on role: around 70% of your time goes to designing and building, and around 30% to leading the team and working with stakeholders. You will work closely with the Product Owner and colleagues in Norway.

**Our stack:** Java and Spring Boot (modular monolith), React and TypeScript, Aurora PostgreSQL (with pgvector), Amazon ECS, SQS and EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Graph, Terraform, GitHub and OpenTelemetry.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Leading the team**

* Lead technical delivery with the team: break features into stories, estimate them, and agree scope and trade-offs with the Product Owner.
* Set up and own the team's engineering practices: coding standards, code review, Definition of Done, branching strategy and short decision records.
* Keep the modular monolith healthy: clear module boundaries, each module owning its data, and boundaries enforced by automated checks.
* Review code, coach the developers and make sure every module has more than one person who knows it.
* Run design workshops with the people who use Nexus and turn what you learn into working software.

### **Building and running the platform**

* Design and build core parts of Nexus: Leads and Cases, gates and status ladders, the pipeline board and forecast, dashboards per role, and master data administration.
* Own the versioned REST API, events and webhooks that tools and integrations use, with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, idempotency keys and a complete audit log.
* Design the integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive through Microsoft Graph, and with our HR, ERP, e-signature, marketing and support systems. Use queued, retried pushes (for example, a transactional outbox) so that no change is lost when a target system is down.
* Enforce access in the code: field and file visibility, partner access per agreement and Case, and server-side checks for the UI, API, add-in and SharePoint.
* Own the AWS environment: infrastructure as code in Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, environments, secrets, backups and cost tracking.
* Keep Nexus fast, reliable and observable: monitoring and alerting, load tests with the QA engineer, regular restore tests against agreed recovery targets, and runbooks.
* Build the single controlled AI service through which all AI model calls go, and help integrate it into the features that use it.

**What success looks like in the first 6 months**
-------------------------------------------------

* AWS environments, CI/CD, automated tests and monitoring in place and used by the whole team.
* Leads and Cases, with access control, audit log and Entra ID sign-in, in production use.
* The team working to agreed standards, with decision records for the key choices.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, including at least 3 years building and running production web services that real users depend on.
* Experience leading or guiding a small team of engineers while still writing a large share of the code yourself.
* Strong Java and Spring Boot skills, and working knowledge of TypeScript and React. You are comfortable working across the stack.
* Sound API and integration skills: REST design, OAuth 2.0 client credentials, webhooks, idempotency keys, and retries with back-off.
* Solid data modelling and experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including performance tuning, migrations and audit trails.
* Hands-on AWS experience: Containers, Lambda, queues and events, S3, IAM, a secrets service, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK). You have set up and run CI/CD pipelines yourself.
* A habit of testing: automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and load tests for the pages and APIs that matter.
* Security and privacy discipline: server-side access control, least privilege, personal data handling under GDPR, encryption and audit logs.
* The judgement to keep a design simple, with clear environments, ownership and monitoring.
* Clear written and spoken English. You can explain trade-offs to non-engineers and work well with colleagues and users in another country and time zone.
* Curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to build with them, including using AI coding assistants with good judgement. You do not need to be an AI specialist.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Microsoft Graph experience with Outlook, Teams or SharePoint, or experience building an Outlook add-in.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including B2B guest users and single sign-on.
* Experience setting up a new team's engineering practices from scratch.
* Experience with event-driven designs, such as the outbox pattern.
* Knowledge of B2B sales processes, CRM systems or qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICC.
* Experience running one application across several regions with separate data residency.
* Hands-on experience with LLM features, for example Amazon Bedrock or retrieval (RAG) with pgvector.
* Experience with enterprise software for regulated industries, or with governance, risk and compliance products.
