### **Description and Requirements**

**Position Summary**

  

This position supports the design, governance and continuous evolution of the organization's Compensation and Total Rewards strategy. The role is primarily strategic and analytical, covering compensation philosophy, salary structures, market competitiveness, annual compensation planning, incentives, pay equity, workforce-cost modeling, benefits design, statutory impact assessment, decision support and employee communication. Routine Payroll and Benefits Administration remain with the respective process teams; this role provides policy direction, specialist advice, governance, controls and outcome assurance.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Benefits Administration, Technology teams, external advisers and service providers, the position converts workforce and rewards data into management insights and recommendations, while ensuring that C&B programs remain competitive, internally equitable, compliant, financially sustainable and aligned with business and talent priorities.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

  
  
  

**1. Compensation Management**

* Assist with the design, review and oversight of Base Pay, salary structures, allowances, variable pay and incentive arrangements.

* Review salary ranges periodically and support appropriate employee and job positioning within the compensation framework.

* Assess proposals for salary changes, new allowances, incentives, compensation plans and exceptions.

* Provide data-based compensation guidance to HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and business leaders.

* Evaluate the compensation implications of organizational and business changes.

  
  

**2. Benefits Management**

* Assist with the design, review and periodic benchmarking of employee benefits, including Group Insurance, Provident Fund, Leaves, Car Lease, National Pension System, Gratuity, Employee State Insurance and wellness programs.

* Review benefit policies, eligibility rules, coverage limits and premium structures periodically to confirm competitiveness, cost effectiveness and statutory compliance.

* Assess proposals for new or revised benefits, policy exceptions and vendor changes, including their cost, employee impact and risk.

* Support annual insurance renewals with claims-experience analysis, premium and cost-impact modeling, and insurer and broker negotiations.

* Provide guidance to HR Business Partners and the Benefits Administration team on interpreting benefit policies and the impact of statutory changes.

  
  

**3. Market Benchmarking and Analytics**

* Coordinate annual compensation benchmarking and periodic benefits studies with external consulting partners.

* Perform job matching; mapping employees to the organization’s jobs/capabilities and to comparable market benchmark roles, so that compensation benchmarking studies can be conducted on a like-for-like basis.

* Analyze market data, salary ranges, internal equity and employee positioning to evaluate competitiveness.

* Translate compensation data into management insights, recommendations, dashboards and decision-support models.

* Maintain robust data-quality checks and reconciliation controls across C&B analyses.

  
  

**4. Strategic C&B Analytics and Management Reporting**

* Own a structured C&B reporting calendar and provide management dashboards, commentary and recommended actions rather than data-only reports.

* Produce annual market-pay benchmarking, market-ratio and rewards-competitiveness assessments to support pay philosophy, salary-range and investment decisions.

* Produce quarterly and compensation-cycle reporting on compa-ratio, range penetration, below-minimum and above-maximum populations, internal equity, gender pay gap, pay compression, new-hire versus incumbent pay, promotion increases, merit differentiation and pay position versus retention.

* Produce monthly or cycle-based reporting on compensation-budget utilization, budget versus actuals, benefits participation and utilization, payroll and benefits reconciliation outcomes and material policy or data exceptions.

* Analyze PF wage and contribution impacts, gratuity provisions, salary-structure compliance and the cost of regulatory changes, with increased reporting when statutory requirements change.

* Apply appropriate analytical methods, including percentile analysis, scenario modeling, correlation and regression-based pay-equity analysis, and clearly distinguish findings, assumptions, limitations and recommendations.

  
  

**5. Annual Compensation Planning**

* Coordinate activities across the annual merit and salary-review cycle.

* Support compensation budgeting, scenario modeling and preparation of employee-level recommendations.

* Validate proposed changes before implementation and coordinate approvals, communication, system updates and change-management activities.

* Provide plan interpretation, analytical review and governance for applicable incentive and variable-pay programs; validate eligibility, targets, payouts, funding and reconciliation outputs prepared by the administering teams.

  
  

**6. Total Rewards Strategy and Workforce Cost Management**

* Support the design and periodic review of the total rewards framework and employee value proposition, including pay philosophy, job architecture, grading and leveling structures, and benefit and recognition programs.

* Conduct pay-equity, internal-parity and pay-compression analyses, and recommend corrective actions to reduce attrition and retention risk.

* Provide compensation guidance on hiring offers, promotions, transfers and retention cases, ensuring consistency with approved salary ranges and pay philosophy.

* Model and track workforce cost, compensation budget utilization and the cost impact of rewards decisions, with variance analysis for Finance and business leaders.

* Prepare and release the annual Total Rewards Statement, giving each employee a holistic, personalized view of the estimated annual value of their compensation, benefits, wellness initiatives, work-life balance programs and career development opportunities offered by the organization, with accurate data and clear communication.

* Track market trends and emerging practices in pay, benefits, wellbeing and flexible rewards, and recommend relevant enhancements.

  
  

**7. Systems, Automation and Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate C&B activities, reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time.

* Document business requirements, review Functional Requirement Documents and convert C&B rules into clear system logic.

* Participate in User Acceptance Testing, defect validation, reconciliation and business sign-off.

* Use Microsoft Excel and other digital or automation tools to improve accuracy, control effectiveness and scalability.

* Partner with technology and automation teams, including MGCC1Hub or any other system, to implement C&B solutions.

  
  

**8. Employee and Stakeholder Management**

* Prepare clear employee communications relating to compensation and benefit programs or changes.

* Handle strategic or complex C&B escalations accurately, promptly and with appropriate confidentiality, while routine transactional queries remain with the relevant service-delivery teams.

* Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, the Payroll and Benefits Administration teams, consultants, insurers and other service providers.

* Interface with Payroll and Benefits Administration teams to define C&B policy and business rules, coordinate approved inputs, verify implementation, review key reconciliations and exceptions, and ensure discrepancies are resolved within agreed timelines without assuming ownership of routine payroll or benefit processing.

* Provide concise analysis and recommendations to support management decisions.

  
  

**9. Governance, Audit, Controls and Risk Management**

* Provide high-level governance of compensation and benefits administration by periodically auditing whether the Compensation, Benefits Administration and Payroll teams follow approved SOPs across salary and incentive administration, Group Insurance, Provident Fund, National Pension System, Gratuity, Employee State Insurance and other benefit programs.

* Create and maintain SOPs for the Compensation, Benefits Administration and Payroll processes, in collaboration with the process teams that execute them, and govern maker-checker controls for the Payroll process, along with risk certifications and sustainable audit trails.

* Conduct periodic, risk-based reviews of sampled compensation changes, incentive payouts, benefit enrollments and premium validations, and of reconciliations completed by process teams, to confirm SOP adherence and documented approvals, and escalate exceptions and discrepancies to process owners for resolution.

* Monitor insurers, benefit vendors, consultants and service providers against agreed service levels and report governance findings to management.

* Support internal, external, statutory and process audits covering compensation and benefits, preparing reconciliations, evidence and responses and tracking observations through closure.

This is a hands-on partnering role with accountability for demand planning, direct sourcing, selection, offer conversion, candidate experience, talent intelligence and recruitment analytics. The role will be expected to challenge hiring assumptions, advise leaders using market evidence and build proactive pipelines for future GCC capability needs.

**What you’ll be doing:**

**1. End-to-end recruitment ownership**

* Own vacancies from approved requisition through sourcing, assessment, offer acceptance and joining.

* Manage screening, shortlisting, interviews, feedback and selection while ensuring timely and evidence-based decisions.

**2. GCC talent strategy and market intelligence**

* Build a clear understanding of Pentland GCC's current and future capability requirements.
* Develop talent maps and ready-now pipelines for critical and difficult-to-hire capabilities.

**3. Direct sourcing and LinkedIn expertise**

* Act as the subject-matter expert for direct sourcing, headhunting and passive-candidate engagement.

* Act as the principal Talent Acquisition partner to GCC Functional Leaders and Hiring Managers.

* Own a transparent, responsive, and inclusive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Represent Pentland's culture, values, and GCC proposition credibly in the external market.

* Capture candidate feedback and use it to improve the recruitment process.

* Determine when specialist agencies are required and manage partners against quality, speed, service, and commercial expectations.
* Optimise the hiring channel mix across direct sourcing, employee referrals, internal talent and agencies.
* Maintain accurate recruitment data and use funnel insights to identify bottlenecks, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Report time to shortlist, time to hire, offer acceptance, offer-to-join conversion, source of hire, direct-hire percentage, agency dependency, cost per hire, requisition ageing and candidate experience.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 6-9 years of progressive Talent Acquisition or Recruitment experience.
* Significant experience working within a GCC/GBS environment or recruiting specifically for GCC organisations in India.
* Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions and levels.
* LinkedIn Recruiter certification or recognised LinkedIn recruiting credential, with advanced hands-on proficiency in LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Strong direct-sourcing, headhunting, talent-mapping and passive-candidate engagement capability.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders and using market evidence to influence hiring decisions.
* Strong knowledge of the Bangalore and wider India GCC talent ecosystem.
* Strong hands-on experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS) to manage requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview workflows, offers, recruitment data and reporting.
* Practical experience with enterprise ATS platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Teamtailor, Workday Recruiting or comparable recruitment systems is required.

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Talent Team Intro Call** - A 30-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
* **Experience Interview** - A more in-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
* **Final Interview** - A final in-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

#### **About the role**

As an Senior Engineering Manager on the Evaluation team, you will lead the technical vision and execution for how evaluation works across all of HackerRank's hiring products - Screen, Interviews and Chakra. As developers shift from writing code line by line to directing AI agents that do it, the old signal, did the code pass, stops being the thing that matters most. What matters more is judgment: how someone frames a problem, evaluates an agent's output, catches what's wrong, and knows when to push further. That's much harder to measure, and almost nobody has cracked it yet. The Evaluation team is working on figuring out what "skill" means for a developer in an AI-first world, and how to actually measure it, including how Chakra, our AI interviewer, scores candidates, and how we score assessments where candidates are allowed to use LLMs to solve real-world tasks.

Your team builds the rubrics and scoring models behind this: a mix of deterministic checks and LLM-based judges, run as production services. You will help build the team from the ground up, lead a group of senior engineers, own the roadmap with Product, and work with the teams behind Screen, Interviews and Chakra to put this scoring into every product.

#### **What you will do**

* Own the vision and roadmap for Evaluation, working closely with Product to shape priorities.
* Lead the team that builds rubrics and scoring models for Chakra and for assessments where candidates use LLMs to solve real-world tasks.

* Set up the checks that show a score is right: golden sets, agreement with human reviewers, and regression tests before scoring changes ship.
* Work closely with researchers and I/O psychologists to make sure our evaluation methodology is defensible.
* Run evaluation as reliable production services, keeping the latency and cost of LLM calls under control at scale.
* Own delivery commitments and run the team's day-to-day execution.
* Hire, mentor and grow engineers, and set clear career paths for each team member.
* Define how the team uses AI tools in development to improve quality and speed.

* Proven record of hiring, leading and mentoring senior engineers, including performance management, and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Clear communicator who is comfortable in fast-moving, changing environments.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Experience building/working on classical ML models.
* You have worked on bias checks or responsible-AI audits of AI systems.

* Enjoy working on a problem that doesn't have a known answer yet, and testing ideas against data.

* Delivering production planning for the KBM/LX conversion - capturing how each plant really plans, including the spreadsheets nobody has written down and the knowledge of experts close to retirement. * Getting planning strategies right - MTS, MTO, ETO and CTO, variant configuration and requirements consumption designed for how each product family is actually built and sold.

You will join a streamlined Operations team that follows a few simple rules. Done means in use. If you are blocked, find another route the same day, inside the rules. AI is expected, and “I don’t know, here is how I will find out” is a good answer here. You will have no direct reports.
